about_the_game:
Enjoy the full, uncompressed soundtrack of Frontier Combat: Beginnings in maximum quality, wherever you are!

The Frontier Combat: Beginnings soundtrack is a catchy collection that captures all the excitement of the battles and events across Boldo Island. Relax with the theme of Poa Town, or get fired up with the standard battle theme!

Features

  • 11 songs in MP3 format.

  • 11 songs in FLAC format, maximum quality.

  • Composed and produced by MMNakamuraZ, the same creator who fully developed Frontier Combat: Beginnings.
